hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.go) go -C "$(dirname "$f")" tool goimports -w "$(basename "$f")";; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.css|*.scss|*.json|*.md|*.html) d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != / ] && [ "$d" != . ]; do if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ]; then case "$d" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) break;; esac; fi; if [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/prettier" ]; then "$d/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write "$f"; break; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
